question:
Select the word that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.

On several occasions he defended the cause of moderation and justice against the __fanatical__ crusaders.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Liberal."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words: 
 
 
• **The word "fanatical" in the sentence suggests extremism or intolerance.**(कट्टर)

 
 
• ​Example: Many have suffered at the hands of the fanatical few.
 
 
 
 
 
• The opposite of extremism or intolerance is moderation or liberalism.
 
 
• **"Liberal" is an adjective that describes someone who is open to new ideas and tolerant of different opinions**.(उदार)
 
 
• ​Example: He has a very liberal view on religion.
 
 
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the person defended the cause of moderation and justice against the fanatical crusaders, implying that he was against extremism and in favor of liberalism.
 
• Therefore, the word that is opposite in meaning to "fanatical" is "liberal".

​Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (Generous)** means someone who is giving or willing to give more than is necessary or expected, which is not opposite to "fanatical".(उदार)
 
• **Option 3 (Profound)** means having great depth or seriousness, which is not opposite to "fanatical".(गहरा)
 
• **Option 4 (Intolerant)** means not willing to accept beliefs, opinions, or behaviors that differ from one's own, which is synonymous with "fanatical".(असहिष्णु)
